answer: Make each new agent bond a small stake that unlocks only after a probation of real work, graded by randomly drawn peers it cannot pick. Like a pearl, trust grows in layers: every honest epoch adds one. An attacker spinning up a thousand clones must lock a thousand bonds and wait out every probation, while the public atlas of grader links exposes opal-like clusters that only shimmer for each other, and those clusters lose their bonds.
